behavior_notes: Initialize starts the daemon then constructs HttpClient; listener arguments hardcode 0.0.0.0 while client URI honors the host argument.
RerunOgamed discards the returned Process instead of updating _ogamedProcess; automatic restart is implemented but process tracking is unreliable.
Transient HTTP retry policy is shared by GET and POST, with no idempotency key or reconciliation for action retries.
ManageResponse unwraps JObject/JArray but directly casts primitive results; malformed 200 bodies can reach a null result dereference.
Empire parser fills numeric-key ship/building/research/LF maps with zeros when absent, narrows ship counts to int and shares one LFBonuses reference across returned entries.
GetTbotIP feeds an absolute URL into a helper forcing UriKind.Relative. SendFleet serializes speed using current culture and leaves duration absent.
BuyOfferOfTheDay recognizes only HttpRequestException 400 as already-bought, while normal error envelopes produce OgamedException; source and docs require correction.
